Description: 

The purpose of this RFP is to obtain maintenance services for existing SCBA filling stations at various fire stations located within City of Nanaimo limits by a qualified Contractor. 

This Request for Proposal is subject to the New West Partnership Trade Agreement, the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (Chapter 5), and the Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (Chapter 19).
